author: (M. Smith, 1937)

note.en: A pheasant snail about 5 mm long, grazing on seagrass and algae. Collected at Punta Mona, Manzanillo and off Cahuita (2000 to 2003). Too small to notice.
note.es: Un caracol faisán de unos 5 mm que ramonea pasto marino y algas. Recolectado en Punta Mona, Manzanillo y frente a Cahuita (2000 a 2003). Demasiado pequeño para notarlo.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Collected at Punta Mona, Manzanillo and off Cahuita.
